description: This file defines the LeaveType entity class in a Human Resource Management system, with properties mapping to database columns via Doctrine ORM annotations. It manages leave type details including name, status, and associations with entitlement and operational country data.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave type with properties for id, name, status flags, country association, and related entitlements.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the leave type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave type.

methods.name: isSituational
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is marked as situational.

methods.name: setSituational
methods.description: Sets whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the leave type as deleted or active.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the operational country associated with the leave type.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Associates an operational country with the leave type.
